create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with a specified sampling distribution
build_ordered_indices: build sampled indices for the multi corpus dataset using the configured distribution and random seed
map_dataset_index: map a global index to its corresponding dataset key and local index within that dataset
batch_by_size: batch indices by size ensuring each batch comes from a single dataset when batch_sample is enabled
collate_multi_corpus_samples: collate samples from the multi corpus dataset using the appropriate dataset collater based on full_id
